correctness.rationale: For each prime p≡3 (mod 8), the quadratic character identities (-1/p)=(2/p)=-1 yield a∈F_p× with a²=-2. The four distinct sites 0, u=(0,1), v=(a,0), v-u carry values (1,-1,ζ,-ζ) and their unnormalized Fourier evaluations at the four sites are pairwise exactly canceling; this establishes σ_p≤4 uniformly, including p=3. For the lower bound p≡3 mod4 implies x²+y² anisotropic. One-point Fourier diagonals never vanish; two-point principal determinant reduces to ζ^{Q(w)}−1 with nonzero w. On any three-point support translate to {0,u,v}; principal determinant (ζ^A−1)(ζ^B−1)−(ζ^C−1)². If C=0 it cannot vanish. If C≠0, all roots nontrivial and comparing positive sines with the unit phase forces A+B=2C as ordinary integers and equality in the sine midpoint identity forces A=B=C; then Q(u−v)=0 contradicts anisotropy. The normalization 1/p is nonzero and does not affect zeros. All quantifiers are analytically proved; checks are finite corroboration only.

value.rationale: The smallest support size with self-disjoint physical and Fourier supports is a natural principal Fourier-matroid invariant explicitly singled out as difficult for p≡3 mod4 in Zhou 2026. The sharp σ_p=4 is an exact infinite-family classification, improving the concrete prior size 2p−2 construction strictly for p≥11; matching impossibility of 1,2,3 points matters independently. The sqrt(-2) arithmetic witness and anisotropy obstruction give structurally meaningful reasons for the congruence restriction; no general downstream theorem or paper-sized claim is needed. It is not simply a table lookup or a renaming of an established numerical invariant.
residual_risks: The p=3 instance is already implied by Zhou’s construction, so value is the uniform infinite family p≥11 and precise obstruction, not a novel p=3 example.
Broader exact minimizers and the p≡7 mod8 family remain open outside this result.
